summary: Mobile-only iteration 32 — final mobile UI polish for parity with web. Verified all 7 requested mobile features against Expo web preview (375x667) after owner login + onboarding skip. All feature testIDs render, all interactions behave as specified, no red-screen, no dead links. Backend testing intentionally skipped per request.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking; same warning reported in iteration_31 — still present from a shared wrapper. Reference: recurring console warning during onboarding + page transitions.
'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Expected on Expo web preview; harmless on device.

action_items: (Nice-to-have, unchanged from iter31) Migrate `pointerEvents` prop → `style.pointerEvents` on shared Pressable/Card wrappers to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:187 — CoachBanner does api.coachHeadline().catch(() => {}) and silently returns null; if the /api/coach/headline endpoint ever regresses, the banner just disappears with no user-visible signal or log. Consider a subtle placeholder or a logger.warn for observability.

app/strategy/[id].tsx:60,73 — MetricExplainer is placed in a horizontal row of small icons; on very narrow devices the SectionLabel + (i) icon + score value could overlap. Not observed at 375px, but worth an ellipsis/flex-shrink pass on iPhone SE 320px width.

src/components/MetricExplainer.tsx:74 — Inner Pressable uses onPress={() => {}} to swallow overlay taps; this is fine but adds a slight tap-latency artifact on web. Consider onStartShouldSetResponder / stopPropagation instead.
